effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may trash any 2 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, by choosing 1 of your Digimon, delete the chosen Digimon and 1 of their Digimon can't suspend until their turn ends.
